The British General IP55 weatherproof outdoor enclosure is a robust electrical box designed for reliable protection of components in external environments. Constructed from durable polycarbonate, this grey enclosure offers IP55 weatherproofing and dust-tight sealing, making it ideal for outdoor electrical installations in gardens, workshops, or commercial premises. Its IK06 impact rating ensures resilience against physical knocks. The enclosure features multiple M25 and M20 knockouts on the top, bottom, side, and rear for flexible cable entry, and can be mounted horizontally or vertically. It operates effectively in temperatures from -20 to 40 °C.
